findings.title: Share the runtime initialization promise.
findings.evidence: 舊計畫範例。現行 ensureRuntimeInitialized 共享 initializationPromise。

findings.title: Create the test harness before running the green check.
findings.evidence: 舊 MVP 開工步驟。現行 package.json 已有 npm test，發行流程可直接使用。

findings.title: Serialize runtime hydration.
findings.evidence: 舊計畫摘錄。現行背景初始化使用單一 promise 並在讀取失敗後重設。

findings.title: Check the run token immediately before sending a prompt.
findings.evidence: 完成能力與來源檢查後，在派發 RPC 前重新檢查 run token。

findings.title: Persist the requested interactive mode for restart recovery.
findings.evidence: 起跑狀態持久化互動旗標，重啟沿用已保存的選項。

findings.title: Allow local data deletion when the archive cannot be read.
findings.evidence: 辨認讀取本機檔案庫失敗，仍進行明確授權的清除流程。

findings.title: Do not erase the recovery checkpoint for an outstanding submission.
findings.evidence: 一家送出或收集失敗仍保留提交 checkpoint 與已落盤的診斷。

findings.title: Keep the selected chair when a debater leaves.
findings.evidence: 非主席的成員離席時保留現有旁觀主席。

findings.title: Do not report a manual reply as saved after a metadata-only write.
findings.evidence: 手補保存需確實存入完整快照，拒絕降級成僅存狀態。

findings.title: Keep the resume plan until recovery can restore the next step.
findings.evidence: 保留暫停到下一階段接手，依已存回覆與派發狀態恢復。揭曉漏段轉手補，無法重建的內鬼首輪停下並保存原回覆。

findings.title: Keep the known user turn when a generic assistant selector matches inside it.
findings.evidence: 已知使用者訊息中的泛用 AI 節點不會誤刪整段使用者訊息。

findings.title: Restrict Send lookup to controls associated with the verified composer.
findings.evidence: 送出僅搜尋輸入框所屬的表單，忽略頁面的回饋按鈕。

findings.title: Discard the buffered reply when the submitted turn is no longer visible.
findings.evidence: 失去已送出提示的可靠對應時丟棄先前的回覆緩衝。

findings.title: Check Gemini readiness against the live editor.
findings.evidence: Gemini 等待送出時重新定位目前編輯器，驗證同一份提示。

findings.title: Sort eligible replies before selecting the latest one.
findings.evidence: 依頁面實際順序比較符合不同選擇器的 AI 回覆。

findings.title: Do not classify normal assistant advice as a provider outage.
findings.evidence: 直接的服務重試通知與內含重試建議的正常回覆分開辨識。

findings.title: Do not assign a repair draft to a different session.
findings.evidence: 補回覆草稿綁定會議、供應商、輪次與故障文本。

findings.title: Use one version expectation for the content script.
findings.evidence: 兩端握手及版本斷言同步到 0.5.2-driver.14，修正首輪快照的舊版號正規表示式。

runs.error: Connection failed: Provider identity verification timed out. Please try again.

dispositions.title: Keep duration-based retry notices classified as errors.
dispositions.evidence: 獨立限時重試通知的回歸測試修前失敗，修後涵蓋數分鐘、指定秒數與含重試建議的正常回覆。

review.scope: 歷史追蹤程式與測試、文件。排除大型生成檔、素材、鎖檔、私人輸出與 Mission Center。
review.rawLogs: 僅隔離資料夾暫存，保存查證摘要。

tests.mode: 本機隔離副本，正式套件與工作區逐位元核對

remaining: 五家登入態完整長會議、商店送審與發布
